blocks.en: Exploration in EVE involves using scanning probes to locate cosmic signatures in space which may contain hackable containers with items inside, resources like gas clouds or ore, wormholes to distant star systems, or collections of NPCs which may drop rare items. As a profession, exploration can be profitable and engaging, and offers better rewards for players willing to travel in more dangerous space. It has a low skill barrier, and new players can start exploring almost from day 1.
blocks.zh: EVE 中的探索，是指使用扫描探针在太空中定位宇宙信号。这些信号可能是装有物品、可以破解的容器，可能是气云或矿石之类的资源，可能是通往遥远星系的虫洞，也可能是一群会掉落稀有物品的 NPC。作为一种职业，探索既能赚钱又很有趣，而且愿意前往更危险空间的玩家能获得更好的回报。它的技能门槛很低，新玩家几乎从第一天起就可以开始探索。

blocks.en: Players will learn what skills are required to start exploring, what ships and equipment are best for the new explorer, what sorts of areas can be located using the exploration mechanics, how to use probes to track down hidden exploration sites, and how to use analyzer modules to hack into loot containers in exploration sites.
blocks.zh: 玩家将了解开始探索需要哪些技能、哪些舰船和装备最适合新手探索者、利用探索机制可以找到哪些类型的区域、如何用探针追踪隐藏的探索站点，以及如何用分析仪装备破解探索站点中的战利品容器。

blocks.en: Scanning
blocks.zh: 扫描

blocks.en: Main article: Probe scanning
blocks.zh: 主条目：探针扫描

blocks.en: The main object of an explorer is to track down hidden areas found in systems across all of the EVE universe. These areas contain valuable items or other points of interest, but cannot be warped to initially. Instead, a player must use their ship's scanner and their Probe Launcher to track down the “signals” of these hidden areas through a process generally referred to as “probing,” or “scanning,” or “exploring.” If you’ve ever heard someone mention that they are going to “probe down a site”… this is it!
blocks.zh: 探索者的主要目标是追踪散布在 EVE 宇宙各个星系中的隐藏区域。这些区域里有值钱的物品或其它值得关注的东西，但一开始无法直接跃迁过去。玩家必须使用舰船的扫描器和探针发射器，追踪这些隐藏区域的“信号”，这个过程一般称为“扫描”“放探针”或“探索”。如果你听人说过要去“扫个点”……说的就是这个！

blocks.en: You’ve found a quiet system to explore and are safely nestled in a comfortable spot. Cocoa and blankets are optional. Time to explore! Pop open your ship’s scanner using the little button on your ship’s HUD that has a picture of a radar screen on it (or press ALT + P). While you were parking your ship somewhere, your scanner was busy! It’s more than likely tracked down a few points of interest throughout the system. Note that if your scanner readout says “No Signals Detected,” that means the system is currently empty. Head to a different system to explore, but note that you can always come back to this system again later to see if anything juicy has appeared.
blocks.zh: 你已经找到一个安静的星系来探索，并且安全地待在一个舒服的位置。可可和毯子随意。开始探索吧！点击舰船 HUD 上画着雷达屏幕的小按钮（或按 ALT + P）打开舰船扫描器。在你找地方停船的时候，扫描器可没闲着！它很可能已经发现了星系里的几个目标。注意，如果扫描器显示“未探测到信号”（No Signals Detected），说明这个星系目前是空的。换个星系去探索吧，不过你随时可以再回来看看有没有出现什么好东西。

blocks.en: When you first enter a system, none of its Cosmic Signatures will have any identifying information besides a generic designation, such as “MRM-213”. However, much like Cosmic Anomalies, Cosmic Signatures come in several types. You just won’t know exactly what you are tracking down until you pull out your probes!
blocks.zh: 刚进入一个星系时，所有宇宙信号除了一个通用编号（比如“MRM-213”）外没有任何识别信息。不过，和宇宙异常一样，宇宙信号也分好几种类型。只是在放出探针之前，你不会确切知道自己在追踪的是什么！

blocks.en: A Good Place to Start
blocks.zh: 从哪里开始

blocks.en: When you first begin exploring, you will likely want to stick to high-security space: systems with a security status anywhere from 0.5 to 1.0. You will be pretty safe in these systems, but there are some best practices you can start to follow so that they are routine as you move into exploring more dangerous space.
blocks.zh: 刚开始探索时，你大概会想待在高安空间，也就是安全等级在 0.5 到 1.0 之间的星系。在这些星系里你会相当安全，不过有一些好习惯可以从现在开始养成，这样等你进入更危险的空间探索时，它们就已经成为习惯了。

en: Explore in quiet systems

Pop open your Star Map and set it to look for “Number of players in the last half hour.” This will set your map to display large or small circles that indicate how much traffic a particular system has seen recently. In high-sec space, your biggest annoyance as an explorer will be other high-sec explorers: there are only so many exploration sites out there, and you will be racing other explorers for them. Areas with lots of traffic typically won’t have any exploration sites of interest to you, and the ones that do appear will likely be pounced on by someone else. Don’t get into a tug-of-war with other high-sec explorers: find a quiet stretch of systems somewhere and do your exploration there!
Explore from a safe place

While probing for exploration sites, your ship will be motionless for extended periods of time. This is dangerous in many parts of EVE. In high-sec, you will probably be perfectly safe idling some distance from a dockable station, or, say, 100km out from a planet. You will be even safer if you have a cloak fitted and activate it when you get to your spot. Indeed, you can explore cloaked so long as you remember to launch your probes first before engaging the cloaking device. In low-sec and other dangerous parts of space, you will want to explore from what's called a Safe Spot, and you will pretty much always want to be cloaked. You can find more info on locating and using Safe Spots in the Bookmarks lesson, and high-sec is a great place to get in the habit of using Safe Spots to explore unhindered!

After finding a safe spot for your ship, an extra precaution you can take is to point your ship in a semi-random direction away from the system’s major points of interest and (if you're not cloaked) then activate your Afterburner or Microwarpdrive. You can safely do this while focusing the majority of your attention on your probing. This is very helpful if you are flying without a cloak: the forward momentum makes it harder for hostile players to track you down, and even if they manage to, you will have a head start on them and should be able to escape!
zh: 在安静的星系探索
打开星图，把显示设为“过去半小时内的玩家数量”（Number of players in the last half hour）。这样地图上会用大大小小的圆圈表示各个星系最近的人流量。在高安，作为探索者最大的烦恼是其他高安探索者：探索站点就那么多，你得和其他探索者抢。人多的区域通常不会有你感兴趣的探索站点，就算有，也很可能被别人抢先。不要和其他高安探索者拉锯，找一片安静的星系，在那里探索吧！
在安全的地方探索

用探针扫描探索站点时，你的舰船会长时间静止不动。这在 EVE 的很多地方都很危险。在高安，停在离可停靠空间站一段距离的地方，或者比如离行星 100km 的地方发呆，大概都会非常安全。如果你装了隐形装置，并在到达位置后开启它，就更安全了。事实上，只要记得先放出探针再开隐形，你完全可以在隐形状态下探索。在低安和其它危险区域，你应该在所谓的安全点（Safe Spot）进行探索，而且几乎总是要保持隐形。关于如何找到和使用安全点，可以参阅书签一课。高安是养成利用安全点安心探索习惯的好地方！
为舰船找到安全点之后，还可以多做一项预防措施：让舰船朝着远离星系主要目标的某个半随机方向，然后（如果没有隐形）开启加力燃烧器或微型跃迁推进器。这样你就可以安心地把大部分注意力放在扫描上。如果你没装隐形装置，这非常有用：向前的速度让敌对玩家更难找到你，即使他们找到了，你也有先发优势，应该能够逃脱！

blocks.en: Probing Down an Exploration Site
blocks.zh: 扫出一个探索站点

blocks.en: The goal of probing is to increase a Signature’s Signal Strength to 100%. Your system has a few cosmic signatures listed, and you’re well versed in what could possibly be out there. Let’s probe one down in this video, or as follows below.
blocks.zh: 扫描的目标是把信号强度提高到 100%。你的星系里列出了几个宇宙信号，你也已经很清楚那里可能有什么。我们来扫一个吧，可以看这个视频，或者按下面的步骤操作。

blocks.en: The scanner window, with two Anomalies and a Signature
blocks.zh: 扫描窗口，显示两个异常和一个信号

en: You already have the scanning panel open, but let’s hit F9 to open up the Solar System Map. This is a “wireframe” representation of the system you are currently in, complete with all the major celestials, like planets, moons and the sun. Since you have your scanning window open, there should be some green and/or red dots and spheres on your map. These represent the Anomalies and Signatures currently tracked by your scanner, as well as their general location. Green dots indicate areas that you can warp to, either an Anomaly or a Signature you have scanned down. Red dots or spheres represent the general area in which your ship’s scanner is detecting the signal of a Cosmic Signature. We’re going to have to narrow that down in order to warp there.

The bottom left of your scanner window has an icon that looks a bit like an atom. That’s the shortcut for the “Pinpoint” probe formation. Press it, and your ship will launch its payload of probes and automatically arrange them in a Pinpoint formation. Neat!

You should now notice that some blue spheres have appeared on your Solar System map. That’s the general area that your probes can currently scan. The center probe in this formation is represented by a white box with arrows sticking out of it. You can click and drag those arrows to move the probes around: by default, dragging that center probe will move all the probes together in formation. This is useful. Now, in order to start tracking down a Signature, you will need to drag your probes so they are centered over one of the red Signature dots or spheres and then press the Analyze button on the middle left of your scanning window. This will scan that area more thoroughly with your probes, and will take a few seconds to complete. If the signature’s red sphere is larger than the area your probes’ blue spheres cover, hold ALT and expand the sphere size. This will increase the range of your probes so you can scan the whole red sphere. If all this is done correctly, the scan will complete and increase the Signal Strength of your chosen Signature. This is listed on the far right of your scanning window.

The goal of probing is to increase a Signature’s Signal Strength to 100%. As you continue to increase the Signal Strength, you will begin to learn more and more about the Signature: first, what type of Site it is, followed by the specific name of the site, and then finally, the Signature’s actual location so you can warp to it! Obviously, this is why we’ve picked a ship and equipment that raises the scan strength of our probes: it makes it much easier to get this number to 100%.

Now, it’s unlikely this first scan got the signal to 100%. In order to further increase its Signal Strength, we’re going to have to give our probes more power by reducing the range of their scan. We do this by clicking and holding the outside edge of one of the probe’s blue spheres and then dragging it inward. This will decrease the size of your scan. Now, re-center your probes on your signature’s dot or sphere and hit the Activate button again. If done correctly, your smaller scan area should still catch the Signature and will end up increasing its Signal Strength.
Most Signatures can be probed down by repeating this process: reduce your scan range by a step, re-center your probes on the Signature, and scan! It’s just that easy.
Once you’ve raised the Signal Strength to 100%, the Signature’s Signal Strength will turn into an arrow you can click to warp to the newly located Site. Congratulations! You’re exploring!
zh: 你已经打开了扫描面板，现在按 F9 打开星系地图。这是你当前所在星系的“线框”示意图，包含行星、卫星和恒星等所有主要天体。由于扫描窗口已经打开，地图上应该会有一些绿色和 / 或红色的点和球体。它们代表扫描器当前追踪到的异常和信号及其大致位置。绿点表示可以跃迁过去的区域，可能是异常，也可能是你已经扫出的信号。红点或红色球体表示舰船扫描器探测到宇宙信号的大致区域。要跃迁过去，我们得把范围缩小。
扫描窗口左下角有一个有点像原子的图标。那是“定点”（Pinpoint）探针阵型的快捷按钮。点一下，你的舰船就会发射探针，并自动排成定点阵型。很方便！

现在你应该注意到星系地图上出现了一些蓝色球体。这就是你的探针当前能扫描的大致区域。阵型中心的探针显示为一个伸出箭头的白色方框。你可以点击并拖动这些箭头来移动探针：默认情况下，拖动中心探针会让所有探针保持阵型一起移动。这很实用。现在，要开始追踪某个信号，你需要把探针拖到某个红色信号点或球体的中心，然后点击扫描窗口左侧中部的“分析”（Analyze）按钮。这会用探针更仔细地扫描该区域，需要几秒钟完成。如果信号的红色球体比探针的蓝色球体覆盖的区域大，按住 ALT 扩大球体。这会增大探针的范围，让你能扫到整个红色球体。如果一切操作正确，扫描完成后，所选信号的信号强度会提高。信号强度显示在扫描窗口的最右侧。
扫描的目标是把信号强度提高到 100%。随着信号强度不断提高，你会逐渐了解这个信号的更多信息：首先是站点类型，然后是站点的具体名称，最后是信号的实际位置，这样你就可以跃迁过去了！显然，这就是我们要选择能提高探针扫描强度的舰船和装备的原因：它能让这个数字更容易达到 100%。
第一次扫描不太可能就把信号扫到 100%。要进一步提高信号强度，我们需要缩小探针的扫描范围，以此提高探针的强度。做法是点住某个探针蓝色球体的外缘并向内拖动，这会缩小扫描范围。然后把探针重新对准信号的点或球体中心，再次点击扫描按钮。如果操作正确，缩小后的扫描区域仍然能覆盖到信号，并且会提高它的信号强度。
大多数信号都可以通过重复这个过程扫出来：把扫描范围缩小一档，把探针重新对准信号中心，然后扫描！就这么简单。
信号强度达到 100% 后，该信号的信号强度会变成一个箭头，点击它就可以跃迁到新发现的站点。恭喜！你已经在探索了！

blocks.en: Probing Tips and Troubleshooting
blocks.zh: 扫描技巧与疑难排解

en: You may occasionally come across a Signature that refuses to hit 100%, despite the fact that you have your probes centered on it at their minimum range (0.25 AU). If this happens, there are a couple things you can try before giving up and resolving to raise your probing-related skills.

Holding the SHIFT key down will allow you to maneuver individual probes, rather than your entire formation. If you are using the Pinpoint formation as recommended, you’ll notice that five of the probes are along the same plane, with four hovering around the outside of the center probe. Shift these four probes around the center probe so that they form a cross, with one probe at each cardinal direction. Activate your scanner again: this in and of itself may be enough to make the Signature warpable. If not, move the four probes closer to the center probe. You’ll want to get them pretty close, without having them overlap. Zooming your view in using the mouse wheel will help here. Alternate shifting the cardinal point probes closer and activating your scanner to see if this raises the Signal Strength enough.

If the above isn’t quite enough to get the Signature to 100%, you can try shifting the entire formation of probes in a single direction a very small amount and then re-scanning. Since the dot that represents the Signature’s location isn’t 100% accurate until its Signal Strength is 100%, you can sometimes squeeze out an extra percentage point or two of Strength in this manner. This can be a bit tedious, however, as the margin for error is so small. It’s recommended that you only try this if you are painfully close to 100% Signal Strength!

Note that as a new explorer, sometimes you’ll just plain be unable to scan a Signature all the way down to 100%. This is very unlikely to happen in high-sec space, but if it does, don’t let it get you down. Just remember, one day your skills and equipment will be good enough that no Signature will be able escape your grasp!

After you’ve probed something down, you may notice that your scanner used to have a bunch of Signatures on it, but now does not. This is because launching probes and reducing their range has removed those Signatures from your scanning region. This is easy enough to remedy, however. You can either expand your probes’ range to their maximum and re-scan, or temporarily switch the Spread formation and re-scan a larger area. In both cases, make sure your probes are covering as large a space as possible: the entire system, if you can. That should find those missing Signatures easily!

While scanning, once you have a signature down to a single dot, double-click the signature in the scanner window. This will center your star system map on the signature, and, more importantly, make the camera rotate around it (instead of around the sun), which makes moving and aligning your probes much easier.
zh: 你偶尔可能会遇到某个信号，即使探针已经以最小范围（0.25 AU）对准它的中心，也死活到不了 100%。遇到这种情况，在放弃并下决心去提升扫描相关技能之前，还有几招可以试试。

按住 SHIFT 键可以单独移动某个探针，而不是整个阵型。如果你按推荐使用定点阵型，会发现有五个探针位于同一平面上，其中四个围绕在中心探针外侧。把这四个探针围着中心探针摆成十字形，东南西北各一个。再扫描一次，光这样可能就足以让信号变得可以跃迁。如果不行，就把这四个探针往中心探针靠近一些。要让它们挨得很近，但不要重叠。用鼠标滚轮放大视图会有帮助。交替把四个方位的探针往里移、然后扫描，看看信号强度能否提高到足够的程度。
如果上面的方法还差一点点才能让信号达到 100%，可以试着把整个探针阵型朝某个方向移动很小的距离，然后重新扫描。由于代表信号位置的点在信号强度达到 100% 之前并不完全准确，用这种方法有时能多挤出一两个百分点的强度。不过误差范围非常小，操作起来有点繁琐。建议只在信号强度已经非常接近 100% 时才尝试！
注意，作为新手探索者，有时你就是没办法把某个信号扫到 100%。这在高安空间中很少发生，但如果真遇到了，也别灰心。记住，总有一天你的技能和装备会好到没有任何信号能逃出你的手掌心！
扫出某个目标后，你可能会发现扫描器里原本有一堆信号，现在却没有了。这是因为发射探针并缩小其范围后，那些信号已经不在你的扫描区域内了。这很容易解决：你可以把探针范围扩大到最大并重新扫描，或者临时切换到分散（Spread）阵型，扫描更大的区域。无论哪种方式，都要确保探针覆盖尽可能大的空间，如果可以的话覆盖整个星系。这样应该就能轻松找回那些消失的信号了！
扫描时，一旦某个信号缩小到单个点，在扫描窗口中双击该信号。这会让星系地图以该信号为中心，更重要的是，镜头会围绕它旋转（而不是围绕恒星），这样移动和对齐探针会容易得多。

blocks.en: Collaboration
blocks.zh: 协作

blocks.en: Collaboration with other capsuleers can increase one's productivity. Through the use of bookmarks corp members can share signatures, and via various third-party tools players can share additional information.
blocks.zh: 与其他克隆飞行员协作可以提高效率。通过书签，军团成员可以共享信号；通过各种第三方工具，玩家还可以共享更多信息。

blocks.en: Mapping tools generally focus on wormhole chains to be used by travelers. EVE University uses the Wanderer mapper.
blocks.zh: 地图工具一般侧重于虫洞链，供旅行者使用。EVE University 使用 Wanderer 地图工具。

blocks.en: Using Wanderer: LSC Server
blocks.zh: 使用 Wanderer：LSC 服务器

blocks.en: Additional third-party tools are available for mapping wormhole chains. The organization EVE-Scout and corp Signal Cartel maintains a publicly-available map of Thera connections on their website and 3rd-party tool Tripwire.
blocks.zh: 还有其它第三方工具可以用来绘制虫洞链。EVE-Scout 组织和 Signal Cartel 军团在其网站和第三方工具 Tripwire 上维护着一份公开的席拉（Thera）连接图。

blocks.en: Site types
blocks.zh: 站点类型

blocks.en: Exploration sites are divided to cosmic signatures and cosmic anomalies based on how they are located. Cosmic Anomalies are areas of interest that radiate a strong enough signal that you can jump to them immediately after your ship scanner finds them. You don’t need to do any fancy probing or anything: just click and go! Of course, since everyone can easily see these sites, they’re typically less rewarding, and possibly more crowded than Cosmic Signatures. Cosmic Signatures are the bread and butter of an explorer. These are hidden areas that cannot be warped to unless tracked down by probes. Because of this extra step, Cosmic Signature exploration areas can be very lucrative, even in high-sec space!
blocks.zh: 根据定位方式的不同，探索站点分为宇宙信号和宇宙异常。宇宙异常是信号足够强的目标区域，舰船扫描器发现它们后就可以立即跃迁过去。不需要任何复杂的探针扫描，点一下就能走！当然，由于每个人都能轻松看到这些站点，它们的收益通常较低，而且可能比宇宙信号更拥挤。宇宙信号才是探索者的饭碗。这些是隐藏区域，必须用探针扫出来才能跃迁过去。正因为多了这一步，即使在高安，宇宙信号类的探索区域也可能非常赚钱！

blocks.en: Combat sites
blocks.zh: 战斗站点

blocks.en: Main article: Combat sites
blocks.zh: 主条目：战斗站点

blocks.en: Combat sites can be found in many flavors. They all share the common element of killing rats for rewards. Combat sites are generally split into two categories, anomalies and signatures, depending on how they are found.
blocks.zh: 战斗站点有很多种类。它们的共同点是击杀海盗 NPC 获取奖励。根据发现方式的不同，战斗站点一般分为两类：异常和信号。

blocks.en: The most commonly found combat sites are combat cosmic anomalies. They are visible in scanner window as soon as you jump into a system and require no specialized scanning equipment. They are always ungated pockets in space with multiple waves of rats.
blocks.zh: 最常见的战斗站点是战斗类宇宙异常。一跳进星系就能在扫描窗口中看到它们，不需要专门的扫描装备。它们都是没有加速门的太空区域，有多波海盗 NPC。

blocks.en: A specific type of cosmic anomalies is besieged covert research facility. These sites are found in low security space only and are harder than the normal anomalies. The rats in these will attempt to shoot into your lowest resist so omni tank is needed.
blocks.zh: 有一种特殊的宇宙异常是“被围困的秘密研究设施”（besieged covert research facility）。这类站点只出现在低安空间，比普通异常更难。里面的海盗 NPC 会专打你抗性最低的伤害类型，所以需要全抗配置。

blocks.en: Combat cosmic signatures are harder to find. They need to be scanned with probes and are generally rarer than anomalies. They are made up of several “rooms” of deadspace connected by Acceleration Gates, and they frequently have containers filled with great loot. Of course, they are also guarded by large numbers of NPC ships. These combat sites are further divided into unrated and DED rated complexes. The differences between the two are mostly cosmetic.
blocks.zh: 战斗类宇宙信号更难找。它们需要用探针扫描，一般比异常稀有。它们由若干个通过加速门连接的死亡空间“房间”组成，经常有装满好东西的容器。当然，也有大量 NPC 舰船把守。这些战斗站点又分为无评级和 DED 评级的复合体，两者的差别主要在外观上。

blocks.en: Relic and Data sites
blocks.zh: 遗迹站点与数据站点

blocks.en: Main article: Relic and data sites
blocks.zh: 主条目：遗迹站点与数据站点

blocks.en: Relic and data sites require hacking to gain access to the goods. They are found by scanning with probes. They can be divided into groups based on what challenges they contain.
blocks.zh: 遗迹站点与数据站点需要通过破解才能拿到里面的东西。它们需要用探针扫描才能找到。根据其中包含的挑战，可以分成几类。

blocks.en: Pirate relic and data sites do not contain any dangers. You just need to scan the site down, hack the containers with and grab the goods. This is usually done in defenseless frigate in lawless space so watch out for other players. Drone data sites are similar but failing the hack spawns hostile drones. The drones are weak and even T1 scanning frigate can handle them. Pirate relic and data sites are found in normal space and class 1-3 wormholes. In drone regions only drone data sites are found.
blocks.zh: 海盗遗迹站点和数据站点没有任何危险。你只需要扫出站点，破解容器，然后拿走东西。这类站点通常是在无法无天的空间里用毫无防御能力的护卫舰来做，所以要提防其他玩家。无人机数据站点与之类似，但破解失败会刷出敌对无人机。这些无人机很弱，即使是 T1 扫描护卫舰也能对付。海盗遗迹站点和数据站点出现在普通空间以及 1-3 级虫洞中。在无人机星域只会出现无人机数据站点。

blocks.en: Ghost Sites are dangerous data sites found in all categories of space. In them you have limited time to hack and a single failed hacking attempt will trigger the container to explode, dealing high explosive damage to your ship. These sites can be identified from "Covert Research Facility" in their names.
blocks.zh: 幽灵站点（Ghost Sites）是危险的数据站点，在所有安全等级的空间中都会出现。在里面破解有时间限制，只要失败一次，容器就会爆炸，对你的舰船造成高额爆炸伤害。这类站点的名称中带有“秘密研究设施”（Covert Research Facility），可以据此辨认。

blocks.en: Sleeper caches are the most complicated data sites. They contain traps and environmental hazards, single mistake can get poorly fit ship killed. The come in three flavors: Limited Sleeper Cache, Standard Sleeper Cache and Superior Sleeper Cache. The limited sleeper cache is for frigates while the other two require more powerful ships.
blocks.zh: 冬眠者储藏点是最复杂的数据站点。里面有陷阱和环境危害，装配不当的舰船一个失误就可能被击毁。它们分为三种：有限冬眠者储藏点、标准冬眠者储藏点和高级冬眠者储藏点。有限冬眠者储藏点适合护卫舰，另外两种则需要更强的舰船。

blocks.en: Gas sites
blocks.zh: 气云站点

blocks.en: Gas sites contain gas clouds that can be harvested for resources. The resources gathered in normal space are used for boosters while the resources in wormholes are used in T3 production.
blocks.zh: 气云站点中有可以采集的气云资源。在普通空间采集的资源用于制造增效剂，而虫洞中的资源用于 T3 生产。

blocks.en: In certain regions there are also gas site combat sites. These sites contain two waves of rats and containers that need to be hacked to get access to the rewards. They contain drug related commodities, blueprints, implants and skillbooks.
blocks.zh: 在某些星域还有气云战斗站点。这类站点有两波海盗 NPC，以及需要破解才能拿到奖励的容器，里面有与药物相关的商品、蓝图、植入体和技能书。

blocks.en: Ore sites
blocks.zh: 矿石站点

blocks.en: Ore sites are cosmic anomalies and do not require probes to be located. These sites are temporary pockets filled with either ice asteroids, which can be mined for fuel components, or regular asteroids of a rarer type not normally found in that system. You can tell what kind of asteroids are within the site by the site’s name: they’re pretty obvious.
blocks.zh: 矿石站点属于宇宙异常，不需要探针就能找到。这些站点是临时性的区域，里面要么是冰矿（可以开采用于制造燃料组件），要么是该星系通常不会出现的较稀有的普通小行星。通过站点名称就能看出里面有什么样的小行星，一目了然。

blocks.en: Wormholes
blocks.zh: 虫洞

blocks.en: Main article: Wormholes
blocks.zh: 主条目：虫洞

blocks.en: Wormholes are temporary gates that can take your ship from your current system to almost anywhere else in space. They are cosmic signatures and need to be scanned with probes. Some wormholes go to highsec, lowsec, or nullsec space, and are sometimes valuable shortcuts around the universe. Some go to dangerous “uncharted” areas referred to as “wormhole space” or “w-space.” W-space areas contain the most lucrative exploration sites in the game, but most of them are guarded by powerful Sleeper NPCs, even the Relic and Data Sites that are so tame in high-sec. (As of the Phoebe release in late 2014, nullsec Relic and Data sites with Sansha, Blood Raider, Guristas, Angel and Serpentis in their names are unguarded sites in WH space. So after learning more about WH's, if you have enough data/relic skills, you could consider running these.) For these reasons, at the start of your career, you should leave wormholes alone... but don’t forget about them! Later articles will go into how you can begin dipping your exploration toe into the vast, untamed pond of wormhole space. See the Wormholes information.
blocks.zh: 虫洞是临时性的通道，可以把你的舰船从当前星系带到宇宙中几乎任何地方。它们属于宇宙信号，需要用探针扫描。有些虫洞通往高安、低安或 00 区，有时是穿越宇宙的宝贵捷径。有些则通往危险的“未知”区域，即所谓的“虫洞空间”（w-space）。虫洞空间有游戏中最赚钱的探索站点，但大多数都由强大的冬眠者 NPC 守卫，即使是在高安中十分温和的遗迹站点和数据站点也不例外。（自 2014 年底的 Phoebe 版本起，名称中带有萨沙、血袭者、古斯塔斯、天使和天蛇的 00 区遗迹站点和数据站点，在虫洞空间中是无人守卫的站点。所以在进一步了解虫洞之后，如果你的数据 / 遗迹技能足够，可以考虑去做这些站点。）由于这些原因，在职业生涯初期，你最好别碰虫洞……但也别忘了它们！之后的文章会介绍如何开始涉足广阔而未被驯服的虫洞空间。请参阅虫洞相关信息。

blocks.en: Sites in Wormhole Space
blocks.zh: 虫洞空间中的站点

blocks.en: Wormhole space has its own sets of sleeper sites unique to each wormhole class. The sleepers defend these sites, for more information see Wormholes.
blocks.zh: 虫洞空间有一套自己的冬眠者站点，每个虫洞等级各不相同。这些站点由冬眠者守卫，更多信息请参阅虫洞。

blocks.en: Lower class 1-3 wormholes also contain pirate data and relic sites. These are identical to sites found in normal null security space.
blocks.zh: 较低的 1-3 级虫洞中也有海盗数据站点和遗迹站点，与普通 00 区空间中的站点完全相同。

blocks.en: Other Sites
blocks.zh: 其它站点

blocks.en: There are some more sites which involve both hacking and combat:
blocks.zh: 还有一些站点同时涉及破解和战斗：

en: AEGIS Capital Ship Security Facility
SCC Secure Key Storage
zh: AEGIS 旗舰安保设施
SCC 安全密钥储存库

blocks.en: Both sites are very dangerous, and it is best to avoid them until you have gathered enough information on how to run them. Both sites involve PVE combat, avoiding mines, and hacking. However, they are also very lucrative. They can be found in Lowsec.
blocks.zh: 这两种站点都非常危险，在充分了解如何完成它们之前最好避开。两者都涉及 PvE 战斗、躲避地雷和破解，但收益也非常高。它们出现在低安。

blocks.en: Survival
blocks.zh: 生存

blocks.en: As with most things in EVE, the more dangerous the environment the higher the rewards. Exploration in HighSec tends to have low return on time, but the minigames are far easier and the risk of attack is far lower. As you start moving into more and more negative space the rewards begin to go up significantly. However, by the time you start running sites in null sec you will most likely want to have T2 modules and appropriate rigs for your exploration vessel. This will typically mean that you will be running sites in a ship that has little to no defensive or offensive capability beyond being fast and hopefully cloaky. You may also not have an opportunity to sell your loot frequently, this can lead to a cargo hold full of 100's of million of ISK in a hull that is paper thin.
blocks.zh: 和 EVE 中的大多数事情一样，环境越危险，回报越高。在高安探索的时间回报率往往较低，但小游戏要简单得多，遭到攻击的风险也低得多。随着你进入安全等级越来越低的空间，回报会显著提高。不过，等你开始在 00 区做站点时，你很可能会希望给探索舰船装上 T2 装备和合适的改装件。这通常意味着你做站点时所驾驶的舰船，除了速度快、最好还能隐形之外，几乎没有任何防御或进攻能力。你也可能没机会经常出售战利品，结果就是一艘薄如纸片的船里装着价值数亿 ISK 的货物。

blocks.en: Outside of high-sec, it is common for other players to scan you down, not just with the traditional combat probes, but with core scanner probes as well - since you will be in a scannable location. While running the site, and particularly while in the minigame, keep your overview and Local visible, and keep running D-Scan. If you see any probes zero in on you, move quickly away from the structure you are looting and cloak up or warp out. A well used Stealth Bomber, Recon ship, or T3 Cruiser, can make extremely quick work of you, and turn a nice profit in the process. Also keep in mind that somebody else may be there already and cloaked. Especially as you start interacting with the first structure - watch your Local and be ready to run fast. A cloaked stealth bomber could just be chilling waiting for you to start the minigame and lose situational awareness.
blocks.zh: 在高安以外，其他玩家扫出你的位置是很常见的事，不仅会用传统的作战探针，也会用核心扫描探针——因为你所在的位置是可以被扫出来的。做站点时，尤其是在小游戏中，要让总览和本地频道保持可见，并持续使用定向扫描。如果发现有探针在向你收拢，赶紧离开你正在搜刮的建筑，开启隐形或跃迁离开。一艘操作得当的隐形轰炸舰、侦察舰或 T3 巡洋舰能非常迅速地解决你，还能顺便赚上一笔。还要记住，可能早有人隐形待在那里了。尤其是在你开始和第一个建筑互动时，要盯着本地频道，随时准备快速撤离。一艘隐形轰炸舰可能正悠闲地等着你开始小游戏、失去态势感知。

blocks.en: When on approach to a site you can make a nearby escape bookmark on your way in. This acts as a quick bugout location that lets you still keep a D-Scan eye on the site you are running to see who comes in.
blocks.zh: 在前往站点的途中，可以顺手在附近做一个逃生书签。它可以作为快速撤离的地点，同时让你仍能用定向扫描盯着正在做的站点，看看有谁进来。

blocks.en: Remember, even though you have invested in scanning down the site, and may be close to finding the system core, it probably isn't worth risking your ship and your cargo to finish a particular structure or site.
blocks.zh: 记住，即使你已经花了功夫扫出站点，也许离找到系统核心只有一步之遥，但为了完成某个建筑或站点而拿舰船和货物去冒险，多半是不值得的。

blocks.en: Also note - when running some sites in wormholes there will be Sleepers, and all of the above still holds except local won't help and the locals may have already scanned the site so may not need to drop probes on you (of course this can also hold true anywhere - but what's life without a little risk!)
blocks.zh: 另外注意：在虫洞中做某些站点时会有冬眠者，以上内容依然适用，只是本地频道帮不上忙，而且当地人可能早就扫出了这个站点，根本不需要对你放探针（当然这在任何地方都可能发生——但人生哪能没有一点风险呢！）

blocks.en: PvE combat
blocks.zh: PvE 战斗

blocks.en: A ship for running combat sites is very different from a ship that is for running data and relic sites. Combat sites are much easier to scan than data and relic sites and the scanning is usually done in the same combat ship that is used for running the sites and not in an exploration frigate.
blocks.zh: 用来做战斗站点的舰船和做数据站点、遗迹站点的舰船大不相同。战斗站点比数据站点和遗迹站点好扫得多，通常直接用做站点的战斗舰船来扫，而不是用探索护卫舰。

en: Weapons are of course needed to harm the rats.
You’ll have few high slots available for weapon turrets or missile launchers.
Drones are another option that does not need high slots.
An armor or shield tank.

Tanking goes beyond the scope of this article, but thankfully the University has good lessons in place already for both Tanking. Equipping your ship with a few appropriate tanking modules will increase its survival rate if you decide to tangle with easier NPC targets. Note that you should never try to build both a shield tank AND armor tank on the same ship, and that shield tanking generally requires mid-slots, of which your exploration kit already eats three. Beyond those caveats, a Shield Extender or some Armor Plates might make the difference between a successful retreat and an ejection from your freshly destroyed ship.
zh: 当然需要武器来对付海盗 NPC。
你可用于装炮台或导弹发射器的高槽不多。
无人机是另一个不占高槽的选择。
装甲或护盾坦克。
坦克配置超出了本文的范围，不过好在 EVE University 已经有关于坦克的优秀课程。给舰船装几件合适的坦克装备，可以在你决定对付较弱的 NPC 目标时提高生存率。注意，绝不要在同一艘船上同时做护盾坦克和装甲坦克，而且护盾坦克一般需要中槽，而你的探索装备已经占了三个。除了这些注意事项之外，一个护盾扩展装置或几块装甲附甲板，可能就决定了你是成功撤退，还是从刚刚被击毁的舰船里弹射出来。
